newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sydney Casino faces licence inquiry.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sydney Casino faces licence inquiry.

text.p: Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd said on Friday it welcomed the mandatory licence inquiry to be held by the New South Wales state Casino Control Authority.
The company, which operates the only casino permitted in New South Wales for the next 12 years, said the authority was required to conduct the review within three years of granting the licence.

"It has always been our desire to have the inquiry completed well before the opening of the permanent casino so we can concentrate on launching what will become Sydney's premiere entertainment venue," a company spokesman said.

"Sydney Harbour Casino has made enormous contributions to the state's economy in the 12 months it has been operating. This includes the creation of around 2800 jobs and payments to the Government of more than A$460 million," the spokesman said.
"So we are extremely confident that the inquiry will find that it is in the public interest that our licence should remain in force."
Sydney Harbour, which is 26.3 percent owned by Las Vegas casino operator Showboat Inc, said it would make its own submission.
Sydney's permanent casino is expected to open in November next year.
